title: Local criterion of flatness modulo a nonzerodivisor
statement: Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_A)\subset\mathfrak m_B$) and let $M$ be a finitely generated $B$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], regarded as an $A$-module via $\varphi$. Let $x\in\mathfrak m_A$ be a nonzerodivisor on $A$ such that multiplication by $x$ (that is, by $\varphi(x)$) on $M$ is injective. If $M/xM$ is a flat module over $A/xA$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then $M$ is a flat $A$-module.

proof.text: Put I=(x). Its containment in the maximal ideal of A follows from hx_mem. Mapping along the local homomorphism gives I B contained in the maximal ideal of B, which is contained in the Jacobson radical. Use Ideal.span_le, Ideal.map_mono, IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_le and IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_le_jacobson.

proof.text: The linear map f:A -> I, a |-> a*x, is surjective by Ideal.mem_span_singleton' and injective by regularity of x on A. Form the linear equivalence e with LinearEquiv.ofBijective and its left tensor equivalence M tensor A -> M tensor I. Tensor induction verifies that I.subtype.lTensor M composed with f.lTensor M, followed by TensorProduct.rid A M, equals multiplication by x after the right unitor. Lift two tensors through e.lTensor M; regularity hxM and injectivity of the right unitor make the lifts equal, hence the original tensors equal.

split_report.summary: Statement checked against Stacks 00ML with I=(x) and the remark following it (kept; added the citation [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] for 'finitely generated B-module' and that id to stmt_deps). Not in Mathlib (LeanSearch, Loogle, LeanFinder and grep repeated today: no local criterion of flatness in Mathlib/RingTheory/Flat). Split in two steps following the Stacks remark: (1) for I=(x) with x a nonzerodivisor on A, a -> ax is an isomorphism A -> I, so I (x)_A M ~ M and the multiplication I (x)_A M -> M becomes multiplication by x on M, injective by hypothesis (elementary; this is the remark 'Tor_1^R(M,R/(x))=0 iff x nonzerodivisor on M' read through 00M6, only the needed direction); (2) apply the existing 00ML node lem-weil-pbc-flat-variant-local-criterion, which is stated with the injectivity of I (x) M -> M instead of Tor_1 = 0, so no Tor node (def-weil-pbc-tor-modules) is needed. 00MK and 051C are reached through that node, not here. No new nodes.
